summary.zh: 调优向量索引，平衡延迟、召回与内存
summary.en: Tune vector indexes for latency, recall and memory

description.zh: 围绕 HNSW 参数、量化策略与索引规模，给出延迟、召回率和内存占用的调整方向。适合检索结果不稳或线上查询变慢时排查与优化。需对现有索引结构和可用资源有基本了解。
description.en: Guides tuning HNSW parameters, quantization and index scaling to balance latency, recall and memory. Useful when retrieval drifts or queries slow down. Assumes familiarity with the current index and hardware.
